$comment: (catalog/host.json urls): A Markdown's TEXT asks the host's `textLinks` hook, the one a `hostLinks` Text uses, and paints what it links as a markdown link: the `Markdown/link` look, opened through the URL policy and the host's opener. Replayed by every renderer (React and Solid share web/markdown.ts `linkMarkdownText`, Swift `Markdown.linkText`, Compose `Markdown.linkText`, gpui `markdown::link_text`). THE RULE: a text run = adjacent plain text spans of one format in a paragraph, heading, list item, quote or table cell; bold, italic and strike runs ask too and keep their format. Inline code, a fenced block, a block image's alt and the label of a markdown link NEVER ask. A BARE URL inside a run (`http://` or `https://`, any case, not glued to an ASCII word character before it, up to the next ASCII space, tab or newline) never asks either: only the pieces around it do. Each piece follows the hook's contract: the segments must concatenate back to the piece (else it stays text), a segment whose href the policy denies stays text, null = text. The measure never asks: a link only changes colour and underline, never a width. The hook of this replay: every `#` + uppercase letters + `-` + digits token of the piece that `known` lists links to its `known` value. The default URL policy applies (`javascript:` is denied). `links` = every link the document paints, markdown links too, in document order; everything else is text.

cases.name: an href the policy denies stays text
a block image's alt never links
a markdown link's label stays its own link
a markdown link's destination never links
a bare url in parentheses never links
a ref after a bare url links
a ref glued to a slash outside a url links
a markdown link beside a ref
